name: @mgtitimoli/auth-api
description: REST API for users and sessions

scripts.database:list-migrations: scripts/environment.sh run kysely migrate list --config src/database/kysely.config.ts
scripts.database:migrate: scripts/environment.sh run kysely migrate up --config src/database/kysely.config.ts
scripts.database:migrate-all: scripts/environment.sh run kysely migrate latest --config src/database/kysely.config.ts
scripts.database:rollback: scripts/environment.sh run kysely migrate down --config src/database/kysely.config.ts
scripts.database:seed: scripts/environment.sh run sh -c '[ -n "$1" ] || { echo "Error: seed name is required" >&2; exit 1; }; name=$1; shift; kysely seed run --config src/database/kysely.config.ts --specific "$name" "$@"' --
